description: A PriceProto written by the published ledger-models v0.4.33 (Rust crate): object_class "Price" and version "0.0.1" as strings in fields 1 and 2, and every DecimalValueProto as the string field 10 only. LM-318 replaced fields 1 and 2 in place and deleted field 10, so these bytes are not readable: each language's test pins that parsing fails, or yields an unset type and an absent version. It must never yield a valid type.
